title: 🛫 New Training & missions in MSFS Marketplace|Weekly Update|Master Your Flight Skills! |Week 39 ✈️
description:
🔍 Description
🚀 Discover the latest training missions added to the Microsoft Flight Simulator (MSFS) marketplace this week! This week not only training missions but also other missions are added, including a visit through 6 US states during a bush trip. Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced pilot, these missions offer a comprehensive learning experience. Watch now to see how you can take your flight simulation to the next level! 🌟

📹 Other marketplace additions
If you are looking for either the new enhanced scenery and enhanced airports or new aircrafts and liveries review the respective video by clicking on one if the links below:
